commands.text:
[Best Albums.xlsx](t3-context://v1/file/file_9365bdef-32e7-4d6a-a513-8a98bbc211d7) 

i use the attach spreadsheet to track my favorite yearly albums, and use those rankings to provide favorite lists of artists by decade, and overall, using a weighted score

i've always been disatisfied with the scoring system, and i'd love to be able to search from a catalog of albums and rank them by year using a proper UI, with album covers and all

write the first ticket to spec out MVP requirements for this product and issue a wave of follow up tickets to kick off development

1. create the epic
2. it's hard to describe what i don't like about it - the weights feel kind of arbitrary i guess, take a look at it, critique it, and propose a better option - maybe it doesn't even need to be scoring-based, there could be other algorithms to use

changes 2: 

ditch multiple algorithm support

go with head to head elo algorithm
